text_en: The oracle concerning the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the Negeb sweep on, it comes from the desert, from a terrible land.
text_cn: 有关瀚海的神谕： 犹如风暴由南方扫来；同样，仇敌将由沙漠，由可怕之地而来。

text_en: A stern vision is told to me; the betrayer betrays, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, O Elam, lay siege, O Media; all the sighing she has caused I bring to an end.
text_cn: 一凄惨的神视显示给我：抢夺的尽量抢夺，破坏的尽量破坏。厄蓝，上前！玛待，围攻！我要结束所有的叹息！

text_en: Therefore my loins are filled with anguish; pangs have seized me, like the pangs of a woman in labor; I am bowed down so that I cannot hear, I am dismayed so that I cannot see.
text_cn: 为此我的两腰满是酸痛，侵袭我的剧痛无异产妇的痛苦；我惶乱得不能再听，我昏迷得不能再看。

text_en: My mind reels, horror has appalled me; the twilight I longed for has been turned for me into trembling.
text_cn: 我的心神错乱了，恐怖骤然袭击了我；我所渴望的黄昏，为我反成了恐怖。

text_en: They prepare the table, they spread the rugs, they eat, they drink. Rise up, commanders, oil the shield!
text_cn: 盛宴已摆，华毯已铺，人们正在吃喝之际：“将帅们！起来！用油擦盾！”

text_en: For thus the Lord said to me: “Go, post a lookout, let him announce what he sees.
text_cn: 因为吾主对我这样说：“去！派置一个警卫，叫他报告他所见的！

text_en: When he sees riders, horsemen in pairs, riders on donkeys, riders on camels, let him listen diligently, very diligently. ”
text_cn: 当他见到骑兵队、一对一对的马兵、驴队和骆驼队时，他要注意，要多多注意！”

text_en: Then the watcher called out: “Upon a watchtower I stand, O Lord, continually by day, and at my post I am stationed throughout the night.
text_cn: 守望者喊叫：“吾主！我整日站在瞭望台上，长夜鹄（hú）立在我的守望所。

text_en: Look, there they come, riders, horsemen in pairs! ” Then he responded, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the images of her gods lie shattered on the ground. ”
text_cn: 看哪！来了一队人马，一对一对的骑兵！”有一个喊叫说：“陷落了！巴比伦陷落了！她所有的神像也都摔碎在地！”

text_en: O my threshed and winnowed one, what I have heard from the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, I announce to you.
text_cn: 我那被碾轧的百姓，我那禾场上的子民！凡是我由万军的上主，以色列的天主所听到的，我都告诉了你们。

text_en: The oracle concerning Dumah. One is calling to me from Seir, “Sentinel, what of the night? Sentinel, what of the night? ”
text_cn: 有关厄东的神谕：从色依尔有人向我喊叫说：“警卫！夜已何时了？夜已何时了？”

text_en: The sentinel says: “Morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire; come back again. ”
text_cn: 警卫答说：“黎明已至，然而仍是黑夜；如果你们仍要询问，询问吧！再来一次！”

text_en: The oracle concerning the desert plain. In the scrub of the desert plain you will lodge, O caravans of Dedanites.
text_cn: 有关荒野的神谕：你们在森林中，在荒野里过宿吧！德丹的商旅，

text_en: Bring water to the thirsty, meet the fugitive with bread, O inhabitants of the land of Tema.
text_cn: 请携水出来迎接口渴的人！特玛地的居民，请备粮接待逃难的人！

text_en: For they have fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the stress of battle.
text_cn: 因为他们出逃，是由于面临刀剑，面临出鞘的刀剑，面临已张的弓弩，面临激烈的战争。

text_en: For thus the Lord said to me: Within a year, according to the years of a hired worker, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end;
text_cn: 上主曾这样对我说：“照雇工的年限计，还有三年，刻达尔所有的荣耀都要完结；

text_en: and the remaining bows of Kedar’s warriors will be few; for the Lord , the God of Israel, has spoken.
text_cn: 刻达尔子民的英勇弓手人数，剩下的很少。”因为上主以色列的天主，早就这样说了。
